seo.title: CTV Advertising Checklist for Automotive Brands | Media Planning Tool
seo.description: Complete connected TV advertising checklist for automotive dealerships and OEMs. Cover audience targeting, frequency capping, inventory strategy, and measurement for CTV campaigns.

content.intro: Connected TV is the fastest-growing channel for automotive advertisers, with 61% of car shoppers reporting CTV influenced their purchase decision. This checklist covers every step of planning, launching, and measuring a CTV campaign for automotive brands — from OEM Tier 1 national buys to Tier 3 individual dealer campaigns. Use it to ensure no critical setup step is missed before your first impression serves.

items.title: Define tier-level campaign objectives
items.description: Clarify whether this is a Tier 1 OEM brand campaign (awareness/consideration), Tier 2 regional dealer association campaign (model promotion), or Tier 3 individual dealer campaign (lot traffic/leads). Each tier has different KPIs, budgets, and creative requirements.

items.title: Set household-level frequency caps
items.description: Configure frequency caps at 3–5 exposures per household per week across all publishers. Over-frequency is the number-one CTV viewer complaint and wastes budget on diminishing returns. Coordinate caps across DSP and direct publisher buys.

items.title: Establish DMA-level geo-targeting
items.description: Map campaign geo-targeting to dealership primary market areas (PMAs). For Tier 3 dealers, target the specific DMA or zip codes within the dealer's selling radius. For Tier 2, align to the regional association footprint.

items.title: Upload first-party DMS/CRM audience segments
items.description: Activate dealership CRM data (past buyers, service customers, website VDP visitors) through your DSP or clean room partner. Create suppression lists for recent purchasers (90-day window) to avoid wasting impressions on customers who just bought.

items.title: Allocate budget across premium and FAST inventory
items.description: Split budget between premium SVOD (Netflix, Hulu, Max at $25–45 CPM) for brand-safe, high-attention placements and FAST channels (Tubi, Pluto TV at $14–20 CPM) for incremental reach. A 60/40 premium-to-FAST split is a common starting point for automotive.

items.title: Secure live sports inventory for conquest campaigns
items.description: Reserve CTV sports inventory (NFL on Prime Video, NBA on Peacock) for model launch and conquest campaigns. Sports viewers index high for in-market auto intenders. Expect $35–60 CPMs for live sports streaming.

items.title: Negotiate VCR and viewability guarantees
items.description: Require 90%+ video completion rate (VCR) guarantees in insertion orders. CTV non-skippable formats typically deliver 95%+ VCR, but verify this is contractually guaranteed rather than estimated.

items.title: Produce 15s and 30s big-screen creative
items.description: Ensure creative is designed for lean-back, big-screen viewing — not repurposed mobile or social video. Logo and dealer CTA must be visible in the first 5 seconds. For model launches, hero the vehicle in motion within the first 3 seconds.

items.title: Implement dynamic creative optimization (DCO) for VIN-specific inventory
items.description: Set up DCO templates that pull in real-time VIN-level inventory data (make, model, trim, price, image) to serve locally relevant ads. This is especially impactful for Tier 3 dealer campaigns where showing actual available inventory drives lot visits.

items.title: Verify co-op compliance for dealer-funded campaigns
items.description: Confirm creative meets OEM co-op program requirements: approved disclaimers, APR/lease disclosure per TILA/Reg Z, OEM brand guidelines, and approved channel eligibility. Non-compliant creative risks co-op reimbursement denial.

items.title: Set up store visit measurement
items.description: Activate geofencing-based store visit measurement (via Foursquare, Cuebiq, or DSP-native measurement) to attribute dealership lot visits back to CTV ad exposure. This bridges the 8–12 week automotive purchase funnel from impression to physical visit.

items.title: Configure cross-publisher reach deduplication
items.description: Implement household-level deduplication across publishers using a unified measurement partner (iSpot.tv, VideoAmp, or Comscore). Without deduplication, unique reach will be overstated by 15–30%.

items.title: Track VDP views as a leading conversion indicator
items.description: Set up Vehicle Detail Page (VDP) view tracking as the primary digital conversion event. VDP views per campaign dollar is the most meaningful mid-funnel metric for automotive CTV campaigns before showroom attribution data becomes available.

pro_tips: Layer CTV with programmatic display retargeting to re-engage households after CTV exposure. Sequential messaging from CTV awareness to display retargeting with model-specific creative drives 2–3x higher VDP engagement.

Use model-year changeover periods (August–September) to increase CTV frequency for clearance messaging while simultaneously running conquest creative for the incoming model year — just ensure audience suppression prevents the same household from seeing both.

For EV-specific campaigns, separate your CTV audiences into early adopters (target with performance/technology messaging) and mainstream-curious buyers (address range anxiety and charging access). These segments respond to fundamentally different creative strategies.

Coordinate with your paid search team: CTV campaigns consistently lift branded search volume by 15–25%. Ensure branded search budgets are increased during CTV flight windows to capture the downstream demand you're generating.
